title: 第48章 三方乱战 （一）
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈家祖祠地面，碎石乱飞，血气冲天。

“轰！”

刘莽双手合握两百斤重的巨斧，浑身黑铜色的气血燃烧，一斧便将陈家祖祠那扇厚重的朱红大门连同门框彻底砸碎。

他带来的近百名炼气期弟子紧随其后，法器灵光交织成一片，声势浩大。

然而，大门碎裂后，露出的却是一片死寂的庭院。

整个陈家祖祠空无一人，冷清得诡异。

刘莽眉头一皱，脚下一顿，铜铃大眼里闪过一丝惊疑。

“刘莽，你这蠢货，本座等的就是你送上门！”

陈万河那讥讽的声音猛然从四面八方虚空中传来，带着毫不掩饰的杀意。

话音未落，整个陈家祖祠的地面剧烈颤抖起来。

青石板成片成片地裂开，一道道水桶粗细的血色光柱自地底暴射而出。

空气中原本稀薄的血雾在瞬间变得粘稠无比，带着浓烈的血腥味。

九阴血河阵被提前全面启动了！

惨叫声瞬间连成了一片。

冲在最前方的十余名刘家炼气初期弟子根本来不及祭出防御法器，双脚刚接触到那冲天的血光，浑身皮肉便在弹指间融化成暗红色的血水。

大片大片的血雾顺着阵法纹路倒灌回地底，甚至连两名炼气后期的刘家长老也因为护体灵光被血水腐蚀，惨叫着化为白骨。

“陈万河，老子生撕了你！”

刘莽见状目眦欲裂，他哪能不明白自己被算计了。

但他作为筑基初期体修，肉身强悍，此刻双脚猛地踏地，体表泛起阵阵铜光，凭借着暴烈的气血硬生生扛住了脚下喷涌的血水。

“开！”

刘莽暴喝一声，手中巨斧狂舞，带起刺耳的破风声，将身前拦路的三道血色光柱生生劈碎，大步流星地朝着祖祠内堂深处杀去。

地面大乱的瞬间，在祖祠偏殿死角处的陈凡动了。

他没有理会地面上刘莽与陈家弟子的厮杀，右手一翻，一枚散发着土黄色微光的土遁符已被他拍在身上。

法力涌入，陈凡的身形在土黄色光芒中快速沉入地下，直插位于地底三十丈处的地下血窟。

然而，刚一穿透最后的土层，刺目的血光便险些让陈凡睁不开眼。

方圆百丈的地下血窟此时已沦为熔岩般的血池，中央那座三丈高的白骨祭坛上，无数凡人的生魂正在疯狂哀嚎，血晶亮起妖异的红芒。

血鹰老怪正盘坐在祭坛正上方。

他左手掐诀，大口大口地吞噬着四周汇聚而来的血晶精华，原本因为本命法宝受损而有些枯槁的面容，正在以肉眼可见的速度恢复，气息甚至隐隐还要往上涨一截。

陈万河并不在地下，他正在地面上全力主持大阵，但筑基中期的神识却始终死死锁定了地底。

在陈凡现身的刹那，地底虚空中便响起了陈万河冰冷的怒喝：“本座就知道，还有一只隐藏在暗处的老鼠！”

陈凡面沉如水，没有半句废话。

既然潜入已经暴露，那便无需再藏。

他浑身一震，伪装筑基初期的法力波动轰然爆开，露出了他真实的筑基中期圆满修为。

气海中，早已按捺不住的紫金色金螭剑化作一道刺目的金芒，激射而出。

“斩！”

陈凡并指如刀，向前狠狠一挥。

三重剑意毫无保留地加持在飞剑之上，金螭剑带起一记长达数丈、至阳至锐的庚金剑气，撕裂了四周粘稠的血雾，直奔白骨祭坛最核心的阵眼斩去。

祭坛顶端的血鹰老怪猛然睁开双眼，血瞳中闪过一抹掩饰不住的惊怒：“庚金剑修？！你就是斩断玄儿手臂之人！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the ground of the Chen Family Ancestral Temple, rubble was flying everywhere, and blood was rising to the sky.

"Boom!"

Liu Mang held a giant ax weighing two hundred kilograms with both hands, and with the black copper blood burning all over his body, he completely smashed the heavy vermilion door of the Chen family ancestral temple and its frame with one blow of the ax.

Nearly a hundred Qi-refining period disciples he brought followed closely behind, and the magical weapons and auras intertwined into one, creating a huge momentum.

However, after the door shattered, what was revealed was a lifeless courtyard.

The entire Chen Family Ancestral Temple was empty and strangely deserted.

Liu Mang frowned and paused, a trace of surprise flashed in Tong Ling's big eyes.

"Liu Mang, you idiot, I'm waiting for you to come to my door!"

Chen Wanhe's sarcastic voice suddenly came from the void from all directions, with undisguised murderous intent.

Before he finished speaking, the ground of the entire Chen Family Ancestral Temple began to tremble violently.

The bluestone slabs cracked into pieces, and blood-colored light beams as thick as buckets shot out from the ground.

The originally thin blood mist in the air became extremely viscous in an instant, carrying a strong smell of blood.

The Nine Yin Blood River Formation has been fully activated in advance!

The screams instantly became one.

The dozen or so disciples who were in the early stages of Qi refining from the Liu family who rushed to the front had no time to use their defensive magic weapons. As soon as their feet came into contact with the soaring blood, their skin and flesh melted into dark red blood in the blink of an eye.

Large swaths of blood mist flowed back into the ground along the lines of the formation. Even the two elders of the Liu family who were in the late stage of Qi refining were screamed and turned into white bones because the protective aura was corroded by the blood and water.

"Chen Wanhe, I will tear you apart alive!"

Liu Mang's eyes were about to burst when he saw this. How could he not understand that he had been plotted against?

But as a physical practitioner in the early stage of foundation building, his body was strong. At this moment, his feet slammed on the ground, and bursts of copper light appeared on the surface of his body. He relied on his violent energy and blood to withstand the blood spurting under his feet.

"Open!"

Liu Mang shouted violently, and danced wildly with the giant ax in his hand, making a harsh sound of breaking wind, smashing the three blood-colored light pillars blocking the way in front of him, and strode towards the depths of the ancestral temple.

At the moment when the ground was in chaos, Chen Fan, who was in the blind corner of the ancestral temple, moved.

He ignored the fight between Liu Mang and the disciples of the Chen family on the ground. He turned his right hand and found an Earth Escape Talisman that exuded an earthy yellow light and was patted on his body.

Mana poured in, and Chen Fan's figure quickly sank into the ground in the earthy yellow light, directly inserted into the underground blood cave thirty feet underground.

However, as soon as it penetrated the last layer of soil, the dazzling blood almost made Chen Fan unable to open his eyes.

The underground blood cave with a radius of 100 feet has been reduced to a lava-like blood pool. On the three-foot-high bone altar in the center, countless mortal souls are wailing crazily, and the blood crystals glow with a strange red light.

The old monster Blood Eagle is sitting cross-legged directly above the altar.

He made a secret with his left hand and devoured the blood crystal essence gathered around him. His face, which had been somewhat withered due to the damage to his magic weapon, was recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his aura was even faintly rising.

Chen Wanhe was not underground. He was presiding over the formation with all his strength on the ground, but his consciousness in the middle stage of foundation building was always locked on the ground.

The moment Chen Fan appeared, Chen Wanhe's cold and angry shout rang out in the underground void: "I knew there was a rat hiding in the dark!"

Chen Fan's face was as dark as water, and he didn't say any nonsense.

Now that the infiltration has been exposed, there is no need to hide anymore.

His whole body was shaken, and the mana fluctuations he had pretended to be in the early stage of foundation building exploded, revealing his true and perfect cultivation in the middle stage of foundation building.

In the sea of ​​​​qi, the purple-gold Golden Chi Sword, which had long been unable to be restrained, turned into a dazzling golden light and shot out.

"Cut!"

Chen Fan pointed his fingers like a knife and swung forward fiercely.

The triple sword energy unreservedly empowered the flying sword. The Golden Chi Sword brought up a Gengjin sword energy that was several feet long and extremely sharp. It tore through the thick blood mist around it and went straight to the core of the Bone Altar to strike.

The old monster Blood Eagle at the top of the altar suddenly opened his eyes, and a flash of unconcealable anger flashed in his blood pupils: "Gengjin Sword Cultivator?! You are the one who cut off Xuan'er's arm!"
